place_text: US military databases (hacked from the UK)

tellings.difference: Puts the number of officers at 40 rather than 11 or 12, and adds a space supply-chain theory.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Gary McKinnon's 2001 hack turning up a list of non-terrestrial/off-planet officers.

as_told.title: McKinnon's list of non-terrestrial officers; space supply-chain theory

plain: Around 2001 or 2002, a British hacker named Gary McKinnon broke into US military computers from the UK and, by his account, came across a page listing "off planet officers", meaning military officers who serve somewhere other than Earth. Michels retells this from what McKinnon has said, in one episode as "this list of 11 or 12 off Planet officers" and in a later one as a list of "non-terrestrial officers of which there are 40", where he also adds his own theory about a supply chain in space. If true, it would point to a hidden military presence beyond Earth.
